Ben — good summary. A few quick thoughts:
- 22% on a three‑year locked-in commitment is larger than our standard term bands unless we get a very high frontload. We should avoid setting a precedent over 18% without additional commercial levers.
- Recommend: offer two concrete options to BrightLoop (we give them choice + preserves negotiating leverage):
  1) 36mo @ 18% with 40% frontload + 12m true‑up + dedicated capacity clause (preferred for long-term coverage)
  2) 24mo @ 20% with 50% frontload + more conservative breakpoints (if they insist on more discount)
- Must include SLA credit language (uptime/response) and a 12m ramp protection to handle seasonal spikes.

Looping in Marissa for quick approval on the 18% path if we accept the dedicated resource requirement. Karthik — want your read on revenue recognition and whether Finance can live with the proposed frontload/true‑up mechanics.
